items.exampleEn: Long ago, soldiers from the north invaded this town.
items.exampleZh: 很久以前，一群從北方來的軍人入侵了這座小鎮。

items.exampleEn: A policeman helped the old lady across the road.
items.exampleZh: 一位警察扶那位老太太過馬路。

items.exampleEn: Be careful. There are thieves on this train.
items.exampleZh: 小心，這班火車上有小偷。

items.exampleEn: In this game, you have to rob a train.
items.exampleZh: 在這個遊戲裡，你要去搶一列火車。

items.exampleEn: This stamp has a picture of a bird on it.
items.exampleZh: 這張郵票上有一隻鳥的圖案。

items.exampleEn: The bank robbery was in the news.
items.exampleZh: 那起銀行搶案上了新聞。

items.audioEn: The policeman told us to wait at the corner.
items.audioZh: 那位警察叫我們在轉角等。
options: Go to the next bus stop
Call a taxi for all of us

items.sentenceEn: Insects invaded our kitchen last summer.
items.sentenceZh: 去年夏天，蟲子入侵了我們的廚房。

items.sentenceEn: I need a stamp for this letter.

items.stemEn: The police caught the ____ who took my wallet.
items.stemZh: 警察抓到了偷我皮夾的小偷。

items.stemEn: Two men tried to ____ the bank, but the police came quickly.
items.stemZh: 兩個男人想搶銀行，但警察很快就來了。

items.passageEn: Last night, there was a robbery at a small shop near my home. A man came in and told the owner to give him all the cash. Then he ran away. The shop owner called the police, and a young policeman came quickly. He asked for the owner's surname and wrote everything down. "Don't worry. We will find him," he said. The next day, the police found the man at the bus station.
items.passageZh: 昨晚，我家附近的一間小店發生了搶案。一個男人走進來，要老闆把所有現金交給他，然後就跑了。店老闆報了警，一位年輕的警察很快就到了。他問了老闆姓什麼，並把經過都記下來。他說：「別擔心，我們會找到他的。」隔天，警察在公車站找到了那個男人。

questions.questionZh: 隔天警察在哪裡找到那個男人？

referenceEn: Can you tell me your surname?
rubricZh: 「姓」用 surname（寫 family name、last name 也正確）
問句可寫例如 What is…?

items.promptZh: 我爺爺收集了很多舊郵票。
referenceEn: My grandfather has collected many old stamps.
My grandpa collects a lot of old stamps.
rubricZh: 用 stamp 表示「郵票」，很多用複數（例如 many old stamps）
時態可用現在式、現在完成式或過去式（例如 collects、has collected、collected 等）

The next day, the police found the man at the bus station."（原 "Last night, there was a robbery at a small shop near my home. A thief came in and took all the cash. The shop owner called the police, and a young policeman came quickly. He asked for the owner's surname and wrote everything down. \"Don't worry. We will find him,\" he said. The next day, the police found the thief at the bus station."）；改成要老闆交出現金的搶案（robbery 詞義正確）；thief 另有 mcq 正解與單字卡
